dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Bengals (7-3) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Saints
bullets: Commanders Offensive Surge: Fresh off moving to 7-3 (1st in AFC North) with a 20–22 result against Washington, Cincinnati piled up 312 total yards [Dale Altman](https://www.cincyjungle.com/cincinnati-bengals-analysis/206527/bengals-film-room-joe-burrow-has-an-uneven-performance-on-mnf) [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/recap?gameId=401873078). Samaje Perine totaled 97 scrimmage yards and 0 touchdowns while Joe Burrow threw for 300 yards and 2 TDs in Zac Taylor's attack [Bengals & Brews](https://x.com/BengalsBrews/status/2125290813576114240).

Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Zac Taylor and the medical staff evaluate G Dalton Risner (knee), S Kyle Dugger (quadriceps), S Bryan Cook (ankle), and CB Dax Hill (illness) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report. WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb (surgery)) and CB Jalen Davis (hamstring) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation [Anthony Cosenza](https://www.cincyjungle.com/cincinnati-bengals-history/206552/pro-football-hall-of-fame-race-class-of-2027).

Week 12 Saints Outlook: Zac Taylor and DC Al Golden open installation for the New Orleans Saints (3-7, CIN -10, HC Kellen Moore, OC Doug Nussmeier & DC Brandon Staley (Paycor Stadium)) as Cincinnati prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [bengals.com Official](https://www.bengals.com/news/quick-hits-boye-mafe-challenges-nfl-leaders-joe-burrow-tee-higgins-jamarr-chase).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 7-3 (1st in AFC North • #4 Seed in AFC), Cincinnati carries a 95.8% postseason projection, 72.7% AFC North division title mark, and 5.9% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Jason Garrison](https://www.cincyjungle.com/cincinnati-bengals-news/206562/playoff-projections).
